verdict.rationale: Brave's LLM Context endpoint returns pre-extracted page content for results, with no scraping needed and configurable token and URL limits. That clearly goes beyond the short snippets of standard web search, and extra snippets add up to 5 more excerpts per result. However, the content is described as token-budgeted extraction, not guaranteed full page text, and no markdown output format is documented. Missing for 10: evidence of full, untruncated page text retrieval; an explicit markdown output format; hands-on or independent corroboration of extraction quality.
